If this arises from the pancreas this likely represents a  neuroendocrine tumor, with a mucinous cystic neoplasm considered less  likely because of the location. The 3rd portion of the duodenum  courses along the inferior margin of this mass and is inseparable  from it, raising the alternative possibe diagnosis of a  gastrointestinal stromal tumor. On sagittal images, the mass does  appear to arise from the pancreas and indent the duodenum.
